summary: Show saved node configuration offline and clarify operator command help
details: usdb-node config and config --json show grouped saved node settings, bundled network settings and monitor policy with source labels. Both formats redact credentials, URL authentication/query data, arbitrary extra arguments and unknown values, without Docker, RPC, snapshot validation or configuration writes.

Help distinguishes the interactive setup wizard, scripted first-time configure and read-only config. Previously undocumented public options now explain their purpose, units or defaults, including data roots, roles, miner settings, P2P families and monitor thresholds.
operator_actions: Use usdb-node config after setup to review saved settings. Use status separately to check whether running services have adopted them.
